title: Occupancy and Residency Certification — Facility-Letter Allowance in the Survivor Allowance
content:
On an Occupancy and Residency Certification profile reclassified after a certifying borrower's death, a passed due date is re-dated with a survivor allowance made of several allowances added together. One of them is the **facility-letter allowance**:

- **30 days** where two or more facility letters are on file;
- **15 days** where exactly one facility letter is on file;
- **zero days** where none is.

A facility letter is an accepted supporting document on file about the primary borrower, received less than 12 whole calendar months before the handling date, on a plan whose supporting document setting is "none". Whole calendar months are counted as anniversaries of the day number, a month being complete only on the same day number of a later month.

## The 12-month boundary (hypothetical dates)

| Letter received | Handling date | Whole months before the handling date | Counted? |
|---|---|---|---|
| 20 May of one year | 19 May of the next year | 11 | yes |
| 20 May of one year | 20 May of the next year | 12 | no |

## Points of judgement

- A supporting document that is not accepted, or that is about someone other than the primary borrower, is not a facility letter.
- On a plan whose supporting document setting names a document, no supporting document counts as a facility letter, and the allowance is zero days.
